name: Brand settings persist after revisiting Search language
description: Brand direction and the lead email remain intact when the user moves backward and forward.

planSteps.description: Navigate through Business and Services using fictional valid required data
On Search language choose the not-sure option and continue
On Brand select Bold and premium, choose a non-default color, select Warm and local, add a short brand note, and enter leads@example.com
Use Back to Search language, then Continue to Brand
The Brand step retains the selected direction, visible color value, tone, brand note, and lead notification email
